data.novelty: physical layouts new; original logical Horn operators unchanged

evaluation.eligibility: Both async_sound and bounded_progress reach >=.90 train and dev original goal and exact joint-Q accuracy
evaluation.horizons: 4:8, 5:10, plus two extra calls on same graphs
evaluation.independent: Exact Horn oracle and minimum proof depth rederived by separate frontier method; all evidence rows and source hashes checked; sampled native Torch forward and patch replay
evaluation.lean: Lean4.19.0 checks abstract bounded chain and 1,968 prospective 3-target Boolean-Horn theorems; not student proofs
evaluation.primary_gate: In each eligible seed, bounded_progress minus async_sound >=0.05 on BOTH joint-Q and final all-atom accuracy at BOTH depth4/5; deadline_stable_fraction >=0.85; extended Q and extended goal >= baseline-.03; goal >=baseline-.03; informative flip >= baseline-.03; irrelevant-patch retention >=.90; no extra false goals. Eligible failure => FAIL; any ineligible without failure => INCONCLUSIVE; all seed gates passing => PASS.

failure_policy: Keep all trials and negative results; do not tune losses or scores using heldout; protocol changes require AF-15.
scope_limit: Synthetic graph/Boolean-Horn proof state, no claim of general mechanistic interpretability or novel Lean proof discovery

semantics.depth: Minimal rule-derivation height from initial facts, independently recomputed from rules
semantics.no_target_leak: No closure, proof depth, donor labels or deadlines enter recurrent model inputs
semantics.oracle: Original AF-05 finite least Horn fixed point with graph-incidence facts only
semantics.progress: Each reachable atom may arrive at any time through 2*d(v), fact deadline call1; preserve truth at all later recorded calls

title: Bounded progress and persistent semantic Horn closure in the native TypedLoop

training.checkpoint: final step only, save Torch and exact NumPy named-array exports
training.fairness: identical source-cell forward calls, sampler/donors and optimizer updates across arms; auxiliary objective adds backward FLOPs
training.recurrent_cell: original pinned TypedLoop with 15 atom and 14 rule tokens
training.source_weight_policy: Each arm loads same independently verified AF06 qualified warmup for its seed
